action_input.code:
import sqlite3
import pandas as pd

# Load superhero CSV data
superhero_df = pd.read_csv('csv/superhero.csv')

# Connect to the database and load hero_power mappings
conn = sqlite3.connect('db/hero_power.db')
hero_power_df = pd.read_sql_query("SELECT hero_id, power_id FROM hero_power", conn)
conn.close()

# Filter for Super Strength (power_id=18)
super_strength_heroes = hero_power_df[hero_power_df['power_id'] == 18]['hero_id'].unique()

# Filter superheroes by id in super_strength_heroes and height_cm > 200
filtered_df = superhero_df[superhero_df['id'].isin(super_strength_heroes) & (superhero_df['height_cm'] > 200)]

# Count the results
count = len(filtered_df)
print(count)
